protocol.gate: No increase in confirmed public factual-error responses on the affected matched suite; no repeatable loss of a critical strategy. Audit flags and qualitative concerns are tracked separately. No fixed word target.
protocol.review: All public paragraphs and recommendation titles/reasons checked against frozen requests; no automated audit pass treated as prose accuracy.

decisions.A: rollback output/locale duplication reduction: fewer confirmed factual issues in the primary suite, but setup-ace win-condition omissions rise from 2/3 to 3/3 in the targeted regression
decisions.B: rollback scope-unused set-audit deletion: 2/18 before versus 3/18 after confirmed prose issues
decisions.C: retain Singles-only removal of simultaneous shared-move sequencing; isolated final replay has 0/3 confirmed public factual issues versus 0/3 before, with one new internal audit flag. Input falls 2.79%, but cost and latency do not improve in this replay
decisions.further: Retain ownership/state/mechanics safety checks and special-strategy procedures; no untested shortening promoted.
